text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali says in parliament "the government works in full transparency" on privatisation.
- Tourism national commission adopts measures to boost sector.

- Rabat Supreme Court confirms verdict against six Moslem militants, three of whom received the death penalty, for leading an armed attack on a hotel in Marrakesh in 1994 in which two Spaniards were killed.
- Infrastructure sorely tried as torrential rains sweep the coutry.
- Leader of the Labour Democratic Confederation objects to privatisation of telecommunications utility.
- Seminar on telecommunications concludes that government will keep control over the sector despite opening it to private investors.
